summary.detailed:
Technology Director with 15+ years leading engineering organizations across enterprise SaaS, regulated industries, and banking. Engineering degree, Master of Finance, and MBA — a combination that bridges technical depth with financial rigor and business strategy.

Proven record scaling cloud-native platforms on AWS and Azure, directing teams from startup to enterprise scale, and representing technology at the C-suite level. Experienced in multi-tenant B2B SaaS architecture, DevOps transformation, and engineering budget ownership.

Core technical expertise in cloud infrastructure, AWS serverless development, TypeScript/Node.js, software architecture, CI/CD automation, and enterprise platforms, with additional experience in C#/.NET environments.

experience.title: Director of Engineering
experience.detailedDescription:
Lead technology strategy and execution for a multi-tenant enterprise procurement SaaS platform, overseeing software engineering, DevOps, architecture, and QA. Report to the CTO; also served as interim VP of Engineering (February – December 2024), reporting directly to the CEO during a critical growth period.

  • Scaled engineering organization through critical growth phases; established architectural standards and development practices for multi-tenant SaaS expansion
  • Drove cloud infrastructure cost optimization with direct impact on operational margins
  • Implemented CI/CD pipelines, automated testing frameworks, and observability practices across cloud environments
  • Managed vendor relationships, engineering budget, and cross-functional alignment with Product, InfoSec, and Customer Support
Technical Environment: Multi-tenant SaaS architecture, cloud infrastructure, JavaScript/TypeScript, CI/CD, automated testing, observability, vendor integrations

experience.title: Software Engineering Manager
experience.detailedDescription:
Led a team of 14 developers and QA specialists on a mission-critical Workers Compensation SaaS platform, with full accountability for delivery, quality, and team performance.

  • Directed strategic migration from legacy .NET Web Forms to cloud-native Angular applications on Azure
  • Implemented SDLC standards, CI/CD pipelines, and DevOps practices that reduced deployment cycle times across all platform components
  • Managed data ingestion pipelines (XML, ANSI X12, PDF), BI reporting (Crystal Reports, SAP Business Objects), and multi-state regulatory compliance systems
  • Served as technical liaison translating complex compliance requirements into actionable engineering roadmaps for business stakeholders
Technical Environment: .NET Framework, .NET Core, Angular, Azure DevOps, C#, SQL Server, ANSI X12, Crystal Reports, SAP Business Objects

experience.title: Business Analyst
experience.detailedDescription:
Technical bridge between engineering teams and business stakeholders for Workers Compensation SaaS platforms serving state government compliance reporting across the USA. Acted as technical product owner, defining requirements for compliance-focused solutions, managing delivery priorities, and supporting platform operations across multiple state jurisdictions.

Technical Environment: SQL Server, VB.NET, C#, Team Foundation Services

experience.title: Senior Software Developer
experience.detailedDescription:
Progressed from developer to technical lead within 3.5 years, directing a team of 6 on mission-critical enterprise banking systems.

  • Led COBOL-to-.NET modernization initiatives and third-party e-Banking integrations
  • Delivered ETL solutions for Business Objects BI platform and core banking modules (COBIS)
  • Coordinated with Software Architects to establish technical standards; managed project planning (Microsoft Project) and production support
Technical Environment: .NET Framework, C#, SQL Server, COBOL, Business Objects, COBIS
